title: What Does "2nm" Mean in Semiconductors? What the Number Really Is, and the History of Scaling
excerpt: In semiconductors, 2nm does not mean that a specific part is 2nm. This beginner's guide sorts out the difference between node names and actual dimensions, why transistors moved from planar to FinFET and GAA, and what EUV, wiring, yield, and cost have to do with it.
